text: In Oxford's halls where knowledge thrives,
A beacon shines, "The Reuby" arrives.
Students' voices, vibrant and free,
Crafting narratives with creativity.
Sing out, O Reuby, with harmonies pure,
Your pages our stories, enduring and sure.
United in purpose, our visions align,
In prose and in verse, our talents combine.
From science's depths to art's vast expanse,
We explore ideas, inviting all to dance.
Each edition a journey, a quest to find,
The intersections of heart and mind.
Sing out, O Reuby, with harmonies pure,
Your pages our stories, enduring and sure.
United in purpose, our visions align,
In prose and in verse, our talents combine.
O Reuben College, cradle of thought,
Through "The Reuby," our passions are taught.
We celebrate voices, both young and old,
In this tapestry of wisdom, our stories are told.
Sing out, O Reuby, with harmonies pure,
Your pages our stories, enduring and sure.
United in purpose, our visions align,
In prose and in verse, our talents combine.
As seasons turn and new minds convene,
"The Reuby" stands, ever serene.
A testament to our collective voice,
In its chorus, we rejoice.
